basic_info.description: Don't miss this beautifully remodeled home, very large room sizes, new kitchen, new bath, formal LR and DR, refinished hardwood floors, huge garage with room for two cars.  Lots of opportunity for possible ADU (check with city), nice sized back yard, perfect for a garden and outdoor pleasure's.  One block to Golden Gate Park and the beach just minutes away.  Five minutes to the Golden Gate Bridge and for a Marin commute.
